  Scenario: AC7 The release holds the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR11 of section 8
    When the release is deployed and its artefacts are checked
    Then BR1 and BR2 hold: one login, and the migration is a per-service Flyway sequence in schema rwb_case that creates no treatment object
    Then BR3 and BR4 hold: every subscription has a retry and a .dlt topic, and no timer-check Schedule, timer-check job or TimerDue topic exists
    Then BR5 and BR9 hold: no new topic is created for this capability and the stuck workflow scan JOB-21 is reused
    Then BR6 and BR10 hold: no environment value is hard-coded and no dashboard series, log line or alert payload carries personal data
    Then BR7 and BR8 hold: every alert carries its message ID where it has one and links one runbook entry, and a refused read is counted and never pages
    Then BR11 holds: no business value is a deployment value
